comparisonCriteria.materialRegression: candidate median exceeds baseline median by both 20 percent and 5 ms in a matched measurement cell; investigate rather than silently accept
comparisonCriteria.percentiles: No tail percentile claims from 15 healthy or 5 fresh samples; report median/minimum/maximum/range
comparisonCriteria.interpretation: Fresh resident measures resident startup, not cold OS file cache. No universal latency or unmeasured platform claims.

declaration.initializationReadiness: Parent elapsed until actual declared executable is observed blocked in arm64 read(0,...), input withheld; 1ms polling adds observation overhead. This proves readiness to consume input, not completion of all initialization or resident readiness.
declaration.interleaving: Variants alternate within each round, with order reversed on odd rounds; no excluded warmup samples
declaration.fixture: Fresh git repository per installed variant; identical offline Pi before/retire registration protocol, tool edit, no source edit/provider execution. Ready and fresh resident cases separate; exact executable/startticks/lifetime recorded.
declaration.environment: Inherited host environment without NODE_OPTIONS, NODE_V8_COVERAGE, REVIEW_* or HAPSLAND_*; perfixture REVIEW_RESIDENT_DIR/STATE_PATH/ACTIVITY_PATH/USER_CONFIG_PATH. No live backend calls. OS file cache uncontrolled; host load recorded.
declaration.expectedDuration: 20–40 seconds; finite runner deadline180seconds plus bounded owned resident cleanup
declaration.candidateLineage: Ordinary BOTH-profile archive prepared from committed36feade3; archive/clean/setup passed, exact retained prefix installed with pinned Bun1.3.14.
declaration.coordination: Run after concurrent acceptance/build processes are terminal. Freeze candidate archive and installed bytes through measurement; record host load and avoid concurrent CPU-heavy work.
declaration.residentEvidence: Every healthy sample must prove compatible baseline resident reuse using executable identity, live process startticks and lifetime before/after calls. Each fresh sample must use a distinct fresh resident lifetime, with owned cleanup verified; preserve the runner per-sample evidence.

fileCache: uncontrolled OS cache; new client process for every sample
measurement: parent monotonic clock; full installed before-command wall time; outcomes retained on failure
